name: Funny Dark Rabbit
effectText: This card is treated as a Toon monster while "Toon World" is on the field. After you Normal or Special Summon this card, you can Normal Summon 1 monster that mentions "Toon World" during your Main Phase this turn, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn). Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can take 1 "Toon" Field or Continuous Spell from your Deck and either add it to your hand or place it face-up on your field.
